cohort: 520 women residing in Ballabgarh Block of District Faridabad, Haryana, India, whose antenatal, intrapartum, and postnatal period coincided with the first wave of COVID-19 pandemic
finding: Fewer women received the recommended maternal healthcare services during the COVID-19 pandemic, particularly full antenatal care.
mod_finding: The proportion of cesarean deliveries was significantly higher in private facilities compared to government facilities.
